tables.name: cut_approval_instance
checks: checklist identity is positive for A/B/C and entirely null for D
hold reason is null unless status=PENDING
APPROVED requires decision_at and null rejection reason; REJECTED requires both decision_at and non-blank rejection reason; non-terminal states require both null
previous/replacement identities reference the same task and form a linear replacement chain

tables.name: cut_approval_node

columns.pending_marker: TINYINT GENERATED AS (CASE WHEN status_code='PENDING' THEN 1 ELSE NULL END) STORED

checks: original/current approver are both positive or both null for unresolved candidate
APPROVED/REJECTED require decision_at and feedback; WAITING/PENDING/CANCELLED require both null
assessment review is null outside SERVICE_MANAGER; CONFIRMED has null reason; NOT_REASONABLE requires reason and REJECTED
route node count and order equal the frozen grade route

tables.name: cut_approval_review_item
checks: item_code is one of the exact five review items
NO requires non-blank reason and YES requires null reason

tables.name: cut_approval_reassignment
checks: from may be null only for an unresolved frozen candidate
from and to differ when from is non-null

tables.name: cut_approval_notification
checks: SENT requires message_id/sent_at and clears retry fields

jsonContracts.source_snapshot: exact immutable ApprovalSourceSnapshot from F-CUT-005-api-contract.json: exact eleven-field project fact, collectionAnalysis{cutoverType,networkMode,scheduledTime} with networkMode preserving legal JSON null, stable ordered submitted risk/business-survey ChecklistResultSnapshot arrays, exact five-dimension AssessmentApprovalSnapshot plus manualGrade, and exact submitted F-CUT-004 PlanSourceSnapshot+PlanContentUnion; no missing/extra keys, no default inference and no current Owner refresh
jsonContracts.route_snapshot: exact grade, ordered nodeCode array and each node frozen candidate identity/fact versions; unresolved candidates use explicit null identities and stable reason
jsonContracts.candidate_fact_snapshot: INITIATOR uses exact userId/projectId/ACTION_EDIT/treeVersion; SERVICE_MANAGER uses exact PROJ fact; SECOND_LINE/RND contain the complete stable SYSTEM candidate set, every candidate's ProjectScope ACTION_VIEW result/treeVersion and the uniquely intersected subject or explicit NOT_UNIQUE from F-CUT-005-candidate-owner-contract.json

lockOrder: PROJ then SYSTEM then ProjectScope Owner locks
platform idempotency/audit/outbox in the same outer transaction

stateTransitions.start: lock and freeze the trusted initiator ProjectScope ACTION_EDIT fact, then create PENDING instance and complete frozen route; INITIATOR=PENDING and later nodes=WAITING; any unresolved candidate sets root holdReason and suppresses all executable todos until correction/reassignment clears it
stateTransitions.approveIntermediate: current PENDING->APPROVED and next WAITING->PENDING; instance remains PENDING and version increments once
stateTransitions.reject: current PENDING->REJECTED, future WAITING->CANCELLED, instance->REJECTED and task P5/APPROVING->P4/PLAN_DRAFTING atomically
stateTransitions.approveFinal: current PENDING->APPROVED, instance->APPROVED, task P5/APPROVING->P6/CLOSURE_IN_PROGRESS and one CutoverApproved outbox atomically
stateTransitions.sourceInvalidation: instance PENDING->PAUSED_SOURCE_INVALIDATED and open nodes->CANCELLED; F-CUT-004 owns same-transaction task P5->P4
stateTransitions.reassign: WAITING/PENDING candidate CAS plus append reassignment; when the complete route is valid clear holdReason and expose only the current PENDING todo

eventOutbox.rule: final approval only; unique per approval instance; notification delivery is unrelated

notificationRetry.commandTransaction: start/approve/reassign only append PENDING notification in the same business transaction and return the business result; they never call the notification provider synchronously
notificationRetry.deliveryRule: a separate post-commit delivery action changes PENDING to SENT, or PENDING_RETRY with server retry time/error when provider invocation fails; failure never changes the already committed approval command and same deliveryKey is reused
notificationRetry.apiBoundary: notification provider failures are not members of approve/reject/reassign error unions; retry delivery has its own operational evidence and production activation requires real provider propagation evidence

authorizationProjection.initiator: original initiator + current ProjectScope ACTION_VIEW may read FULL progress but has no approval action unless also the current qualified node approver
authorizationProjection.currentApprover: current node approver + node-specific current Owner/project scope fact may read FULL and receives APPROVE/REJECT only when root/node are executable
authorizationProjection.readOnlyProjectMember: current ProjectScope ACTION_VIEW may read FINAL_RESULT_ONLY only after APPROVED/REJECTED; source snapshot and node review bodies are never projected
authorizationProjection.todo: only executable PENDING node for current user after the same current Owner/scope revalidation; no partial page on Provider failure
authorizationProjection.administrator: a dedicated stable-paged reassignment-candidates query and REASSIGNMENT_ONLY detail expose only instance/task/open-node/current-assignment/version metadata; REASSIGN only for WAITING/PENDING nodes; permission alone never grants approve/reject or FULL detail; reassign response remains REASSIGNMENT_ONLY

migration.rule: no legacy approval field is copied, upgraded or dual-written; Flyway number is chosen only at serial merge

controlledSubstituteBoundary: CUT unit/integration tests may use deterministic src/test Owner facts and notifications for full positive routes; they cannot register production beans or prove real-browser/Implementation Done
